description: Fleet of generators (possibly on different chains) side by side, to spot the bad node.

targets.expr: count(max by (job, instance) (process_uptime_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})

panels.title: Healthy / unhealthy
panels.description: Healthy when committing blocks (last 10m), lag < 50 and peers > 0. A check whose metric is missing (P2P disabled, head unknown) is skipped. A running process that has not committed a block in 10m is Unhealthy. Down = no data.

targets.expr:
count((min by (job, instance) (
  label_replace((sum by (job, instance) (increase(shinzo_generator_blocks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="success"}[10m])) or max by (job, instance) (process_uptime_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0) > bool 0, "check", "committing", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (job, instance) (shinzo_generator_block_lag{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) < bool 50, "check", "lag", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (job, instance) (shinzo_p2p_peers{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) > bool 0, "check", "peers", "", "")
) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}) == 1) or vector(0)

count((min by (job, instance) (
  label_replace((sum by (job, instance) (increase(shinzo_generator_blocks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="success"}[10m])) or max by (job, instance) (process_uptime_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0) > bool 0, "check", "committing", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (job, instance) (shinzo_generator_block_lag{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) < bool 50, "check", "lag", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (job, instance) (shinzo_p2p_peers{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) > bool 0, "check", "peers", "", "")
) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Fleet committed blocks/min
panels.description: Blocks committed per minute across the selected instances.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (job, instance) (rate(shinzo_generator_blocks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="success"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}) * 60

panels.title: Fleet errors/min
panels.description: RPC errors (method_not_found excluded), failed store attempts and skipped blocks per minute across the selected instances.

targets.expr: (sum(sum by (job, instance) (rate(shinzo_generator_rpc_errors_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", error_type!="method_not_found"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}) or vector(0)) * 60 + (sum(sum by (job, instance) (rate(shinzo_generator_store_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="error"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}) or vector(0)) * 60 + (sum(sum by (job, instance) (rate(shinzo_generator_blocks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="error"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}) or vector(0)) * 60

panels.title: Worst lag
panels.description: Chain head minus committed height. About 3 when caught up (DefaultBlockOffset). Red above 50 (#232 critical). Missing when the head can't be read.

targets.expr: max(max by (job, instance) (shinzo_generator_block_lag{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Restarts across the selected instances in the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (job, instance) (resets(process_uptime_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})

panels.title: Fleet
panels.description: One row per instance, unhealthy first. Lag/height/head/peers are current values; blocks, errors and store p95 use the last 5m; skipped blocks and restarts cover the selected range. Click an instance to open the single dashboard. Healthy when committing blocks (last 10m), lag < 50 and peers > 0. A check whose metric is missing (P2P disabled, head unknown) is skipped. A running process that has not committed a block in 10m is Unhealthy. Down = no data.

targets.expr: max by (job, instance, service_version, shinzo_chain_name, shinzo_chain_network) (target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})

max by (job, instance) (shinzo_generator_block_lag{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

max by (job, instance) (shinzo_generator_block_height{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

max by (job, instance) (shinzo_generator_chain_head{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

max by (job, instance) (shinzo_p2p_peers{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

sum by (job, instance) (rate(shinzo_generator_blocks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="success"}[5m])) * 60 and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

(sum by (job, instance) (rate(shinzo_generator_rpc_errors_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", error_type!="method_not_found"}[5m])) or max by (job, instance) (process_uptime_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0) * 60 + (sum by (job, instance) (rate(shinzo_generator_store_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="error"}[5m])) or max by (job, instance) (process_uptime_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0) * 60 and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

sum by (job, instance) (increase(shinzo_generator_blocks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="error"}[$__range])) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, instance, le) (rate(shinzo_generator_store_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

max by (job, instance) (process_uptime_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

sum by (job, instance) (resets(process_uptime_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

panels.title: Fleet committed blocks
panels.description: Blocks leaving the commit queue across the selected instances, by result. Each error is a block missing from the store.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (sum by (job, instance, result) (rate(shinzo_generator_blocks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}) * 60

panels.title: Fleet errors
panels.description: RPC errors by type (method_not_found excluded), failed store attempts and skipped blocks across the selected instances.

targets.expr: sum by (error_type) (sum by (job, instance, error_type) (rate(shinzo_generator_rpc_errors_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", error_type!="method_not_found"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}) * 60

sum(sum by (job, instance) (rate(shinzo_generator_store_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="error"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}) * 60

sum(sum by (job, instance) (rate(shinzo_generator_blocks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="error"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}) * 60

panels.title: Lag spread
panels.description: Worst, median and best block lag across the selected instances. A wide gap between worst and median points at one bad node (see the per-instance graph).

targets.expr: max(max by (job, instance) (shinzo_generator_block_lag{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})

quantile(0.5, max by (job, instance) (shinzo_generator_block_lag{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})

min(max by (job, instance) (shinzo_generator_block_lag{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"})

panels.title: Committed blocks/min by instance
panels.description: Blocks committed in order per minute.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance) (rate(shinzo_generator_blocks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="success"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

panels.title: Block lag by instance
panels.description: Chain head minus committed height. About 3 when caught up (DefaultBlockOffset). Red above 50 (#232 critical). Missing when the head can't be read.

targets.expr: max by (job, instance) (shinzo_generator_block_lag{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

panels.title: Connected peers by instance
panels.description: Unique peers connected to each embedded DefraDB node. Missing when P2P is disabled or unavailable.

targets.expr: max by (job, instance) (shinzo_p2p_peers{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

panels.title: Block store p95 by instance
panels.description: p95 duration of a single Store attempt.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, instance, le) (rate(shinzo_generator_store_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

panels.title: RPC errors/min by instance
panels.description: Failed Ethereum JSON-RPC calls (not-yet-mined blocks and context cancellation are not counted). method_not_found is excluded: the node lacks the method (e.g. eth_getBlockReceipts) and the generator falls back. Line at 5/min = #232 RPC warning.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance) (rate(shinzo_generator_rpc_errors_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", error_type!="method_not_found"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

panels.title: Skipped blocks/min by instance
panels.description: Blocks that left the commit queue with an error. Each one is missing from the store.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance) (rate(shinzo_generator_blocks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="error"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}

panels.title: Reorgs by instance
panels.description: Reorgs each instance confirmed. Instances on the same chain should see the same reorgs; one that sees more may be served forked data by its RPC node.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance) (increase(shinzo_generator_reorgs_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__interval])) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", shinzo_chain_name=~"$chain", shinzo_chain_network=~"$network"}
